additional_info.subject: RE: ID0482846-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3 314182274001] Check on logs CRM:02889001251
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0482846,
to provide a clarification and adjustment to the previous technical analysis provided.
I analyzed the logs, and the reason why the sessions failed is because the client authorized but never connected the plug:
Outlet DC1 has been authorized at 2026-03-08T13:27:03
No sign of cable connected. At 2026-03-08T13:28:34 the backend sends us a trigger message to communicate the status of outlet DC1, and we communicate it is available, hence no cable has been connected.
At 2026-03-08T13:31:24, the customer authorized DC2:
Again, the plug is not connected to the EV.
Please ignore the analysis provided before on OCPP communication losses. The connection to the OCPP Backend has been stable throughout the whole period of this analysis. The logs previously analyzed refer to internal communication and logging between the Worldline Valina terminal and the charger, which have nothing to do with the authorization process, which was successful. The changes in language are referring to an internal processing of the terminal itself.
In conclusion, there is no OCPP communication loss issue, but the charging attempts failed because the customer authorized but never plugged in the EV.
With kind regards,

this error flag can be caused by network-related issues such as:
a defective or disconnected network cable, a faulty network switch, or power supply problems with the payment terminal. It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured. Additionally, ensuring all connections are secure and swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help identify if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows: Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2  1.
